onboarding-control-center.rationale: Preserve the first-run product guidance while removing copied application UI.
onboarding-control-center.replacement: @applik8s/start-agentic/react owns the browser-safe onboarding component and links to the maintained operations surface.

safe-configuration-guide.rationale: Make the safe local path the default and keep production configuration progressive.
safe-configuration-guide.replacement: Starter is explicitly credential-free and non-production; plan and dedicated/external progression are framework-maintained.

health-readiness.rationale: Replace route-local health inference with provider and workflow observations.
health-readiness.replacement: @applik8s/operations-ui projects bounded operational observations without exposing raw provider evidence.

identity-session.rationale: Keep authenticated session behavior while replacing application-copied auth routing.
identity-session.replacement: @applik8s/identity owns the provider-neutral session contract and server boundary.

application-owned-tenancy.rationale: Retain product-owned organization and tenant semantics without making tenancy a framework primitive.
application-owned-tenancy.replacement: Applications declare their own models, identity relationships, authority scopes, and provider qualifications.

usage-entitlements.rationale: Preserve usage and entitlement extension seams as optional maintained application modules.
usage-entitlements.replacement: @applik8s/usage supplies native relational models without imposing billing or tenancy policy.

conversation-inbox.rationale: Preserve conversation, message, run, event, and memory behavior with one model declaration per entity.
conversation-inbox.replacement: @applik8s/conversations supplies Drizzle-native Applik8s models and ordinary function-native operations.

run-administration.rationale: Preserve operator-facing run visibility without exposing secrets or provider-native records.
run-administration.replacement: @applik8s/operations-ui presents redacted maintained run and workflow observations.

operation-authority-administration.rationale: Replace string role-policy registries with typed operation authority.
operation-authority-administration.replacement: @applik8s/operations owns runtime roles, grants, receipts, and bounded administrative operations.

evaluation-history.rationale: Preserve dataset, scorer, run, case, and result history as composable domain models.
evaluation-history.replacement: @applik8s/evals supplies maintained native models that applications attach to their selected database.

artifact-provenance.rationale: Preserve artifact metadata and provenance while separating bytes into object storage.
artifact-provenance.replacement: @applik8s/artifacts supplies metadata models and Applik8s object-store capabilities own payload transport.

durable-review-workflow.rationale: Preserve review durability while replacing provider-specific workflow and approval plumbing.
durable-review-workflow.replacement: Function-native workflows emit typed durable signals as events and Hatchet remains an injected execution provider.

capabilities.marker: Starter is the credential-free, explicitly non-production first-run default
